source.verifiedBy: Original ZIP independently downloaded; all raw route/profile summaries, scheduled/dispatch/completion offsets, SQL hashes and seven SQL-oracle values inspected.

negativeOriginal.finding: Initial CI correctly FAILED because a request was observed dispatched before its scheduled monotonic deadline. A bounded monotonic-clock recheck resolved the false timing classification; initial failure artifact retained, not promoted as capacity evidence.

interpretation.es: Cuatro ejecuciones reales de 80 solicitudes programadas con un cliente externo y dos silos Orleans en namespaces Podman del mismo host; PostgreSQL confirma 320 COMMIT, 640 asientos y 320 eventos outbox, con 7/7 oráculos por ejecución. Esto acredita solo una prueba funcional breve, no throughput sostenido, p99 de capacidad, HA entre máquinas ni equivalencia MIPS.
interpretation.en: Four real 80-offer replays through an external client and two Orleans silos in Podman namespaces on one host; PostgreSQL independently confirms 320 committed operations, 640 postings and 320 outbox events, with 7/7 oracles per trial. This is a bounded functional smoke, not sustained throughput, capacity p99, independent-host HA or MIPS equivalence.

limitations: Only 80 samples over four seconds per route/profile and one repetition, sharing one Linux physical runner. Routes run sequentially; warm-up, cache and ordering confound any direct/Orleans latency comparison. No sustained capacity, saturation, 3+ repetitions, independent physical load host, SQL lock/pool/GC diagnosis, dated Azure costs, production SLO, mainframe reference workload or MIPS parity. Issue #25 open and E2 partially_verified.
